text:
micah: heads-up — starting v2 preflight rollout for /generate at 22:00 UTC. tagging @nina @james for delegated ops. plan: canary -> slow-shift -> full. deploy-bot will manage weights. please take operator eyes for 22:00-23:00 UTC. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2-preflight-2026-03-21 by micah. Canary shard: eu-west-1. Initial traffic weight: 5%. Will ramp to 10% after smoke passes.

nina: on it. I'll be on ops for the window. micah, can you paste the pinlist and any gateway toggles we need to apply for tenants?

micah: pinlist (initial): tenant-314 (mobile sdk), tenant-42 (partner-sandbox). Gateway toggles: disable header-case-normalizer for those tenants. Commands: `deploybot pin add tenant-314 tenant-42 --reason "mobile header compatibility"` and `deploybot toggle set header-normalizer off --tenants tenant-314,tenant-42`

james: quick smoke — I see a small spike in 5xxs on eu-edge during local replay (not production yet). snippet from edge logs:
```
[2026-03-21T21:58:12Z] request_id=abc123 route=/generate status=502 backend=runtime-1 latency_ms=1234
[2026-03-21T21:58:13Z] request_id=abc124 route=/generate status=502 backend=runtime-1 latency_ms=1189
```
Not sure if it's related to kv-cache bump or new kernel selection.

nina: thanks james. micah — recommend we hold at 10% and add an auto-rollback threshold: error_rate > 2.0% over 5m OR p50 latency > 800ms over 5m. also narrow tenant pins to only tenant-314 for the first pass.

micah: ack. pausing the ramp at 10% and removing tenant-42 from pinlist. running: `deploybot pin remove tenant-42` now.

deploy-bot: Action: pin remove tenant-42 requested by micah. Status: succeeded. Canary paused by micah. Active traffic weight: 10%. Auto-rollback rules set: error_rate>2.0% (5m), p50>800ms (5m). Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and #incidents. :warning:

elaine: I'll update release notes: mention header-normalizer toggle for tenant-314, canary paused at 10% due to eu-edge spike during smoke. Ops runbook updated with rollback thresholds and contact list.

nina: thanks — after 10m of stable metrics we can consider moving to 25%. if errors resurface we'll rollback fully and escalate. Please keep deploy-bot eyes on the metrics and post the baseline numbers here. :thumbsup:

micah: will do. posting baseline (pre-roll): p50=220ms, error_rate=0.1%. I'll post a quick telemetry snapshot in 3m. Leaving thread for on-call handover.

james: +1. I'll keep replay running and watch for any correlation with kernel selection flags. if we hit rollback I'll prepare a hotfix candidate branch.

deploy-bot: Note: next operator step required to resume ramp: `deploybot resume --canary v2-preflight-2026-03-21 --by micah` or automated resume if metrics stable for 10m."
